newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Foreign investment in Portugal rockets in H1 1996.
newsitem.headline: Foreign investment in Portugal rockets in H1 1996.

text.p: Foreign investors raised sharply their net holdings of Portuguese shares and bonds to 637.8 billion escudos in the first half of 1996 from 49.5 billion in the same year-ago period, the Bank of Portugal said.
"Holdings of public debt bonds explain a substantial part of this increase...but the interest of foreign investors in the Portuguese share market rose visibly," it said in a report.

The net investment of foreigners in public debt bonds issued in the domestic market stood at 199.4 billion escudos in the first half of 1996, compared with a net disinvestment of about 350 billion escudos in the same 1995 period.
The Bank of Portugal said most of the bond holdings were in indexed bonds.
